  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

# Welcome to Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.

**“For The Healthier Humankind”**

The definition of Actiza is “**Active zeal**”. We have an active zeal for a healthier world. Actiza
Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. has become a paradigm in pharmaceutical manufacturing, exporting, and
supplying products that meet international standards. Actiza believes in a systematic approach to
all its endeavours. Hence, we have **WHO, GMP, and ISO accreditations** for our business. India has
been a hub for medical tourism, and now it has become an epicentre for pharmaceutical manufacturing,

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

included in many leading abstracting and indexing open access databases like Google Scholar &
ResearchGate. For a complete list, [view here.][42]

IJERT does not charge readers or their institutions for access to more than 25000 published

[

### Why Publish in IJERT ?

### Broad Scope

Impact of your work will have on researchers outside your field and the potential for greater
exposure.

### Indexed

Increase visibility, availability, and readership of your work on internet which attracts good
citations.

### Peer-Reviewed

All articles are evaluated using criteria including the excellence, novelty and significance of the
research or ideas.

In the area of research and innovation, each day we passionately push the limits of science and
engineering by regularly publishing state-of-art peer reviewed research content in **IJERT having**
**more than 2 million articles ****downloads** per year.

IJER 100% emphasis on high quality research content, thorough peer-review which exists on all our
research and review articles , ensuring we publish scientifically sound research across a broad
spectrum of engineering areas.

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

## Vision & values

## Our vision

We are committed to making an impact on people’s lives. We envision a world where there are more
tools available for the treatment of mental health and where conversations about mental health are
destigmatized. There is an urgent need for more innovation. People need new options. Our mission is
to transform mental healthcare. We’re applying our decades of evidence-based research to develop
investigational psychedelics to catalyze therapeutic approaches for mental health conditions. We are
relentlessly exploring and reimagining novel approaches to address unmet needs in the mental
healthcare space, with an initial focus on post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). As a public

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.
[Explore mimOE + Toolsets][45][Explore solution packs][46][Talk to us for consulting][47]

broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

person.”

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI

securely across the continuum, under your control.

**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens

preserved.

て、正常な配列の遺伝子、異常な配列を修復するDNAやRNAなどを標的細胞に送り込みます。

御する技術です。DNAやヒストンの修飾を変えることで、遺伝子がオンまたはオフに切り替わることを可能にし
ます。

私たちの体を構成する約2万種類のタンパク質は、作られるタイミング、場所、量がオーケストラのように非常
に精密に制御されています。これはエピゲノムと呼ばれる遺伝子制御システムによって担われていますが、この
システムが故障すると、不協和音のように病気を引き起こします。当社のエピゲノム編集技術、CRISPR-GNDM®は
、特定の遺伝子のエピゲノムを選択的に標的とし、制御することができます。これにより、不協和音を制御し、
病気を治療することが可能になるのです。

## 遺伝子治療

遺伝子疾患では、DNA配列にエラーや欠陥がしばしば見られ、これらの疾患を根本的に治療するには遺伝子レベ
ルでの治療が必要であると考えられています。遺伝子治療薬は、ウイルスベクターやナノ粒子などの方法を用い
て、正常な配列の遺伝子、異常な配列を修復するDNAやRNAなどを標的細胞に送り込みます。

1 2 3 4

## CRISPRゲノム編集

ゲノム編集は遺伝子治療の新分野の１つです。私たちのDNAをエラーのある特定箇所をピンポイントで狙って切
断したり、切断した箇所に正しい配列を持った遺伝子を挿入したりすることができるCRISPR技術の誕生によって
、これが実用化可能なレベルになったと考えられています。

[ 詳しくみる ][38]
1 2 3 4

## エピゲノム編集

エピゲノム編集とは、遺伝子の塩基配列自体を変えたり、二重鎖切断を行わずに、特定の遺伝子の発現状態を制
御する技術です。DNAやヒストンの修飾を変えることで、遺伝子がオンまたはオフに切り替わることを可能にし
ます。

[ 詳しくみる ][39]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPR-GNDM®

CRISPR-GNDM®は当社が開発したエピゲノム編集技術で、ウィルスベクターに搭載可能なサイズにコンパクト化さ
れたエピゲノム・エディター(編集システム)を、目的の細胞に効率良く送り届け、高い選択性をもって目的の遺
伝子のON/OFFを行うことで疾患を治すことを目指します。

# 全ての命に、光を

### エピゲノム編集のパイオニア

## エピゲノム編集のパイオニア

私たちの体を構成する約2万種類のタンパク質は、作られるタイミング、場所、量がオーケストラのように非常
に精密に制御されています。これはエピゲノムと呼ばれる遺伝子制御システムによって担われていますが、この
システムが故障すると、不協和音のように病気を引き起こします。当社のエピゲノム編集技術、CRISPR-GNDM®は
、特定の遺伝子のエピゲノムを選択的に標的とし、制御することができます。これにより、不協和音を制御し、
病気を治療することが可能になるのです。

## お知らせ

## 遺伝子治療

遺伝子疾患では、DNA配列にエラーや欠陥がしばしば見られ、これらの疾患を根本的に治療するには遺伝子レベ
ルでの治療が必要であると考えられています。遺伝子治療薬は、ウイルスベクターやナノ粒子などの方法を用い
て、正常な配列の遺伝子、異常な配列を修復するDNAやRNAなどを標的細胞に送り込みます。

[ 詳しくみる ][37]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPRゲノム編集

ゲノム編集は遺伝子治療の新分野の１つです。私たちのDNAをエラーのある特定箇所をピンポイントで狙って切
断したり、切断した箇所に正しい配列を持った遺伝子を挿入したりすることができるCRISPR技術の誕生によって
、これが実用化可能なレベルになったと考えられています。

[ 詳しくみる ][38]
1 2 3 4

## エピゲノム編集

エピゲノム編集とは、遺伝子の塩基配列自体を変えたり、二重鎖切断を行わずに、特定の遺伝子の発現状態を制
御する技術です。DNAやヒストンの修飾を変えることで、遺伝子がオンまたはオフに切り替わることを可能にし
ます。

[ 詳しくみる ][39]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPR-GNDM®

CRISPR-GNDM®は当社が開発したエピゲノム編集技術で、ウィルスベクターに搭載可能なサイズにコンパクト化さ
れたエピゲノム・エディター(編集システム)を、目的の細胞に効率良く送り届け、高い選択性をもって目的の遺
伝子のON/OFFを行うことで疾患を治すことを目指します。

[ 詳しくみる ][40]
BUSINESS

## 自社開発モデルと協業開発モデルのハイブリッドによる開発展開

自社開発モデルは、自社でターゲットの選択を行い、開発資金を含めて自社でリスクを取り、よりスピーディー
な開発と高いリターンを目指します。一方で、協業開発モデルでは、パートナーとの間でリスク・プロフィット
のシェアを行います。これによって、自社のリソースだけではまかない切れないより多くのパイプラインを開発

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

[[Blister Packaging and Cartoning Machine]][115]
[Blister Packaging and Cartoning Machine][116]
DPP 270Max ZH 130W Blister Packaging and Cartoning Line utilizes dual-machine intelligent linkage
technology to efficiently and automatically complete all complex operations: blister packaging
process, image capture and unqualified product detection and removal, servo-linked feeding device,
automatic folding of inserts, and precise cartoning of various materials, with a production capacity
of up to 130 cartons per minute. The delivery time for the production line is 20 days, and the
entire interconnected line requires minimal personnel, with only one operator needed.
[View More][117]
[[capsulator machine]][118]
[NJP 1500D Capsule Encapsulator][119]
Capsule filling is a key link in the pharmaceutical and packing industry, and production efficiency
and capsule quality depend on the selected filling equipment. The NJP-1500D pharmaceutical capsule
filling machine capsule filler meets the requirements for efficient and stable production with a
maximum output of 90,000 pharmaceutical capsules in one hour.
[View More][120]
[[capsule encapsulation filling machine]][121]
[NJP 3800D Capsule Encapsulation Filling Machine][122]
Introducing the NJP-3800D Pharmaceutical Capsule Filling Machine, a cutting-edge solution designed
for high-volume capsule filling in the pharmaceutical industry. With a maximum filling capacity of
228,000 capsules per hour, this machine is equipped with a BEKER vacuum pump and a vacuum powder
feeding machine, making it ideal for large-scale capsule filling operations.
[View More][123]
[[automatic cartoning machine]][124]
[ZH-130W Horizontal Cartoning Machine][125]
RQ-ZH-130W horizontal cartoning machine can automatically pack blister sheets,  bottles, tubes,
sachet and etc., with a production capacity of 35-125 cartons/m. It can be connected with blister
packing machine, tail sealing machine, strip packing machine, three-dimensional wrapping machine and
other equipment, the ideal machinery for pharmaceutical, health Products, food, daily necessities
industries and more.
[View More][126]
[[Counting Machine For Soft Gel Capsule]][127]
[RQ-16C Automatic Capsule Tablet Counting Machine Line][128]
RQ-16C Counting Line In Stock, 7 Days Delivery, Core Counting Accuracy>99.8%. Capacity Upper to 70
Bottles/Min. 7*24 Hour Continuous Operation, The Source Factory Direct! Producing RQ-16C Pill Tablet
Capsule Candy Gummy Counter Counting Machinery Line Since Year 1993. RQ-16B Automatic Counter
Counting Bottling Machine Line Source Factory. Local On Site Service
[View More][129]
[[counting machine]][130]
[RQ-16H Automated Counting Machine][131]
The RQ-16H channel tablet counting machine has been designed and implemented with an eye on the
balance between performance and ease of maintenance. First, from a performance perspective, the
RQ-16H machine’s distinguishing features are its high efficiency and accuracy. It can do so in one
minute. It can handle an output of 30 to 70 bottles without hampering its precise operating
characteristics. However, this machine is not only fast and powerful, it is also designed to handle
a variety of small materials like pills, gummies, candies, and more.
[View More][132]
[[Roller Blister Packing Machine]][133]
[DPH-270Max Roller Blister Packing Machine][134]
DPH-270Max roller blister packaging machine is a high-speed blister packaging machine developed by
Guangdong Rich Packing specifically for large pharmaceutical and health care product manufacturers.
It adopts a full servo control system and motion controller, with a production capacity of up to 450
plates/minute. DPH-270Max blister packaging machine can package tablets, capsules, pills, disposable
medical devices, vials, etc. of various specifications, and is compatible with aluminum-plastic,
aluminum-aluminum, paper-plastic and other materials, meeting GMP, North American and European
production requirements.
[View More][135]
[[High Speed Tablet Press]][136]
[HZP-26-40D High Speed Rotary Tablet Press][137]
HZP-26-40D high-speed tablet press can press materials into round, special-shaped, two-color, and
ring-shaped tablets. It has a high speed and a production capacity of up to 260,000 tablets per
hour, and the tablet weight difference is less than 2%. It has integrated automatic filling volume
adjustment, real-time pressure monitoring, residual powder recycling, and single-piece waste
rejection, which meets GMP production requirements.
[View More][138]
